profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer in Media Software Engineering at Disney Media & Entertainment Distribution (DMED)
profile.jobTitle: Principal Software Engineer - Media Software Engineering

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer - Media Software Engineering
positions.description: Media Software Engineering (continuation of previous DTCI/Staff Software Engineer role) -  responsible for leading team of both Java backend and Angular frontend developers along with design/development of systems supporting production operations and workflows.  Involved in strategic group initiatives. Ex. key project/product initiatives impacting team and helping to unblock/facilitate team's technical needs and challenges, evolving team's software stack/best practices, future technologies/projects being evaluated by broader group/team.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Leadership · Java Enterprise Edition · Docker · Spring Boot · Angular

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer in Media Engineering
positions.description:
Media Engineering (continuation of ESPN role) - responsible for leading team of developers along with design/development of systems supporting production operations and workflows.

Technologies: Angular, Bootstrap, HTML5, Java EE 7, JAX-RS (REST), Oracle/RDBMS, NoSQL (Datastax/Cassandra), SOLR.
positions.insights: Skills: Management · Technical Leadership · Technical Architecture · Java Enterprise Edition · Angular

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: Consulting, Software Product Development, Attempts at World Domination

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer in Media Engineering
positions.description:
Java EE/EJB, JBoss, JPA, Angular
Primarily building single page HTML5/angular applications, REST services, and tools for:
- content curation, publication, and distribution to various digital media platforms and partners
- metadata collection/aggregation
- search and retrieval of content for use by the production teams

positions.title: J2EE Architect/Software Engineer Consultant
positions.description: SOAP, SOA, Messaging, JMS, ESB, Sonic MQ, REST, Web Services
